focus_areas: upload & file handling (uploads.py, portal.py attachment routes)
method: single-pass manual static review (defending-code-reference-harness /vuln-scan brief, <15 source files -> auto single mode), no THREAT_MODEL.md used (design already documented in docs/01_기획.md)
notes: No injection sinks (SQL/command/eval/pickle/subprocess) found anywhere in app/. All templates rely on Jinja auto-escape with zero |safe usages. All write/decision endpoints use SELECT ... FOR UPDATE plus conditioned UPDATE ... WHERE status=... for race safety. Scope checks (_can_access, role_required, admin blueprint before_request) are re-evaluated server-side on every request from DB state, never trusted from session alone.
